assumptions: The service clearly distinguishes evidence organization and mapping from legal or assurance opinions.
Customers provide lawful access to source documents and approve every external disclosure.
The initial segment consists of SMEs responding to a real named buyer, tender, or lender request rather than firms reporting voluntarily without a trigger.
Accounting partners can refer or white-label the workflow under commercially workable data-processing terms.
evidence_needed_for_higher_score: Paid triggered engagements, observed hours and adviser cost avoided, acceptance of the same passport by multiple requesters, bounded delivery labor, first-year contribution margin, annual renewal, mapping reuse, and signed accounting-channel referrals would support a higher score.

factors.name: Core insight
factors.rationale: Turning recurring sustainability requests into one evidence-backed source of truth plus bounded requester mappings addresses duplication more directly than one-off report writing. Distribution through accountants is logically connected to source-document access, although the mechanism is still a productized compliance service rather than a singular proprietary insight.

factors.name: Customer pain and willingness to pay
factors.rationale: The Commission confirms that SMEs receive sustainability-information requests from large companies and financial institutions and that repeated requests create administrative burden. The packet has not shown how frequently Polish SMEs face commercially consequential requests or whether they will pay 2,500-8,000 PLN rather than decline, self-serve, or use an accountant.

factors.name: Business model and economics
factors.rationale: Fixed fees, deposits, annual refreshes, and optional mappings can support cash-efficient recurring service revenue with modest startup capital. Manual evidence chasing, exception review, education, quality assurance, and channel commission may cap margin, and neither delivery time nor renewal economics is validated.

factors.name: Market and beachhead
factors.rationale: Supplier SMEs responding to powerful buyers, tenders, or lenders form a broad market, and accounting offices provide a plausible way to cluster them. The initial target remains too broad because request frequency, consequences, and evidence readiness likely vary sharply by sector and buyer.

factors.name: Competitive position and domination potential
factors.rationale: Evidence quality, portability, and cheaper service can differentiate from consulting, but official digital templates are available and accounting firms, ESG consultancies, banks, and procurement platforms can bundle the work. No exclusive channel or segment leadership is established.

factors.name: Expansion potential
factors.rationale: The evidence vault and mapping workflow could extend to more buyer questionnaires, lender requests, tenders, industries, and European markets, with annual updates increasing lifetime value. Expansion depends on requester acceptance and on preventing custom evidence work from overwhelming standardization.

factors.name: Defensibility and durability
factors.rationale: A permissioned mapping library from recurring source documents to VSME fields and requester variants could lower production cost and create useful workflow history. The standard and templates are public, client data remain client-controlled, agreements are nonexclusive, and incumbents can develop similar mappings.

factors.name: Strength of advantage
factors.rationale: Data normalization and evidence checks fit the founder, and the service can start asynchronously within the capital and time envelope. No accounting channel, customer evidence corpus, recognized assurance status, or proprietary distribution is secured.

factors.name: Timing and momentum
factors.rationale: VSME standardization and current buyer and lender requests create a timely implementation window. Its voluntary nature, regulatory simplification, and public digital tooling may reduce urgency or compress the paid service layer as quickly as they create it.

factors.name: Distribution
factors.rationale: Accounting offices already hold trusted SME relationships and relevant records, making referral or white-label distribution structurally attractive. Channel appetite, economics, support burden, and willingness to introduce a separate provider are wholly untested.

factors.name: Execution and risks
factors.rationale: A five-client productized-service pilot is feasible with low capital and can measure turnaround and evidence reuse. Unsupported disclosures, accidental assurance, GDPR and security duties, changing methodology, and unbounded evidence chasing require careful scope and quality controls but are manageable at pilot scale.

highest_value_structural_change: Target one supplier cluster facing recurring requests from a named powerful buyer or lender and distribute through one accounting network, positioning the product as managed evidence extraction and accepted requester mapping tied to deadlines rather than generic VSME report preparation.
main_structural_strength: The opportunity is anchored in an officially recognized repeated information burden and can become a low-capital annual source-of-truth relationship whose evidence is reused across multiple buyer and lender requests.
primary_score_limiter: The standard is voluntary, free official tools exist, and there is no evidence that Polish SMEs or accounting partners will pay for a passport rather than self-serve, bundle the work, or wait until a counterparty forces action.
strongest_disconfirming_evidence: The Commission and EFRAG already offer a digital template and support material, while regulatory simplification may reduce downstream questionnaires, leaving only a small and readily bundled service layer.
